summary: Fidelity Private Credit Company II LLC (the Fund) completed a merger with Fidelity Private Credit Company LLC (the Acquired Fund) on July 31, 2026, pursuant to an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated March 25, 2026. The Acquired Fund merged into the Fund, which survived and was renamed Fidelity Private Credit Company LLC. Acquired Fund units were converted into Fund units based on an Exchange Ratio equal to the closing NAV per unit of the Acquired Fund divided by that of the Fund. The Fund also assumed the Acquired Fund's credit facility obligations. No financial terms or advisor were disclosed; the transaction resembles a merger-of-equals fund consolidation. Watch for post-merger integration and unit pricing implications.
